verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Grafana SDK or client library for any language. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a published OpenAPI spec (a building block from which a developer could generate clients), an official CLI, an MCP server, and as-code provisioning. These are different capabilities, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
